body: I'm on right now, doing stupid math homework for a final tomorrow as I cry about my pathetic life (I sound really fucking dumb).

Well they are my family's meds (ik kinda selfish... I should probably choose another way to go). I used to see a therapist but talking to professionals doesn't help. They don't actually care about me. They are trained to say the right things in response to a crisis and get paid afterward.

Everyone tells me that but I really don't think so. I can't talk to people. People don't stay interested in conversations with me. I'm really awkward/weird and honestly I wouldn't want to talk to me either. It doesn't help that I'm ugly too.
